name: Armando Urteaga
office: Whittier Union High School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 5

items.text: Armando Urteaga is a member of the Whittier Union High School District Board of Trustees, representing Trustee Area 5, having been appointed to the seat in January 2026. He previously served on the East Whittier City School District Board for 20 years, elected five times from 2005 to 2026. He has worked in public education for 30 years as a teacher, dean of students, assistant principal, and principal, and is currently the Executive Director of Human Resources for the Rialto Unified School District. He also served on the Whittier Union High School District Bond Oversight Committee and the CIF State Appeals Committee.
